# FriskAI raises $3.6M from MaC Venture Capital to watch what AI agents do
- It joins a field that has raised over $175 million in 2026 alone.

## Making AI agents visible in production
FriskAI is a small player in a field that’s filling up fast. [Manifold](https://techfundingnews.com/8m-for-aidr-platform-manifold-to-tackle-the-hidden-risks-of-autonomous-ai-agents/) raised $8 million to secure agents at the endpoint. [Geordie AI](https://techfundingnews.com/geordie-raises-30m-series-a-led-by-balderton-to-become-the-security-layer-enterprises-need-as-ai-agents-take-over-their-infrastructure/) closed a $30 million Series A for agent governance. [NeuralTrust](https://techfundingnews.com/neuraltrust-20m-europe-largest-cybersecurity-seed-ai-agents/), which _TFN_ covered when it announced what it calls Europe’s largest cybersecurity seed round, raised $20 million for a similar control layer.
